title: Multiple gateway groups must not reject authorized Prospectus members
description: Given a verified gateway identity containing admin and prospectus-members, when groups arrive in an array, JSON/comma list or space-separated list, then exact project membership authorizes access. Given admin-only or similarly named groups, then access remains denied. Given stale role claims, when config returns 403, then the UI offers a fresh Google access exchange and hides CRM controls. Production Lambda read-only fixture reproduced 403 for [admin prospectus-members] versus 200 for [admin,prospectus-members]. Actual iPad token representation remains unobserved. Fix published in Kanbus 25410911; Prospectus pin and access-pending UI validating before Amplify deploy. No new permissions or group expansion.
